answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 23601 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is it allowed to read quran without wudhu while reading from a website etc? There are many websites that provides full quran for the people to read online. So, when you read quran in this way do you need to have wudhu or not when reading quran using standard computers? What is the rule if we read using mobile equipments such as iphones, other mobile phones or even touch screen computers? Question: Is it allowed to read quran without wudhu while reading from a website etc? There are many websites that provides full quran for the people to read online. So, when you read quran in this way do you need to have wudhu or not when reading quran using standard computers? What is the rule if we read using mobile equipments such as iphones, other mobile phones or even touch screen computers? Answer ID: 23601 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1032/812/D=1431) (1) Yes, it is allowed to do recitation but there is more reward in reciting in the state of wudhu. However, one should not touch the screen while reciting without wudhu. (2) Mobile too carries the same ruling. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
